outcome_definition.task: Price European call options with GPU Monte Carlo; validate against analytic Black–Scholes.
outcome_definition.acceptance: Unrounded average reserve > 1.0; final Test passed verdict and successful process exit.
outcome_definition.reserve: Sum Confidence / abs(MC-BS) for errors > 1e-6, divided by all options. Confidence is discounted 1.96-standard-error width.
